instructions: Which outcome fits this item's weekly inventory review, using `item`?

criteria.monitor: Stock looks sufficient for the next 14 days, so no action is needed.
criteria.reorder_recommendation: A stockout looks likely in the next 14 days and no order is on the way.
criteria.expedite_recommendation: A stockout looks likely in the next 14 days and an order is on the way but may arrive too late.
criteria.human_review: A stockout looks likely in the next 14 days and would be costly, or the signals conflict, so a person should decide.
